decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app sits close to the core dental practice software, so the firm's existing knowledge lets it interpret user feedback and keep improving it as practices digitise.
The continuing education institute builds on the firm's training content and practitioner relationships, which supports customer retention and channels market feedback back into development.
Remote screen sharing support extends the firm's core customer support capability and became more valuable for remote service delivery after 2020.
The performance analytics dashboard draws on data the practice software already holds, and the firm's own R&D can assimilate early results to refine it.
The complete practice bundle repackages established offerings for new practices, so it carries little knowledge risk and directly supports growth.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the firm's software expertise, which limits its ability to learn from results, but it is cheap to run and strengthens ties to the dental community, so it is kept under closer review.
